title: B-tree cursor clear and header-size primitives

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeClearCursor releases a saved cursor key and invalidates position; sqlite3HeaderSizeBtree reports the rounded per-page B-tree header size. These small dependency-free B-tree primitives share direct state/layout semantics.
excluded_responsibilities: Shared-cache sharability already canonically owned by btree-sharability-and-vdbe-usage-lock-masks

external_source_responsibilities: Caller B-tree mutex and target-specific page-header layout
dependencies.caller_closure: Both straight-line source bodies are assigned; ABI/pager integration remains open.

inputs: Live locked Cursor for clear; no input for header size
outputs: Freed saved key and INVALID cursor, and eight-byte-rounded Page header size
contracts.ownership: clearCursor consumes saved_key storage; header observation owns nothing.
contracts.state_and_results: Clear sets saved_key null and state invalid without releasing page path. Header size rounds the active Page owner to eight bytes.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Clear requires cursor B-tree mutex; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid lock/lifetime violates source contract; valid operations are infallible.

representation_differences: Zig saved_key slice allocation replaces source pKey allocation.
Zig Page is the native owner corresponding to source MemPage for the current model; exact cross-language layout assurance remains pending.

oracle.protocol: Transition a valid cursor through clear and compare INVALID state; verify header size is at least Page size and eight-byte rounded.
oracle.normalization: Boolean/state are exact; header size is target-native Zig owner size pending C ABI comparison.

assurance.oom: No allocation; clear may free existing key.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; clear lock precondition external.
assurance.continuation: Cleared cursor may be repositioned later.

integration.native_call_path: Typed primitives and scalar transitions are unit-traced; ABI integration remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires ABI/shared-cache/caller integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Compare Page/MemPage header sizes for target ABI.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/btree_core.zig Cursor saved-key/state and Page owner were reviewed
callees: Source sqlite3_free represented by cursor allocator free; direct state/layout reads otherwise
assertions_branches_cleanup: Saved key is released before invalidation
upstream_tests: Upstream cursor save/clear and B-tree header-size tests cover these primitives
Project tests cover clear state and aligned header bound
